information.summary: Welcome to Registry! An event management tool. It allows in particular the holding of presence registers.

who.content: Registry started on a Camp of Scouts and Guides of France in August 2019. It was created by Luc Aucoin with the help of Alexandre d'Hont and Louis Vicainne (they have merit because I got them well with my ideas.).

service.content: The site provides a platform allowing users to enter, manage and process data. Users are fully responsible for the data they enter, in particular concerning legal obligations relating to the consent of the persons concerned. This under the General Data Protection Regulations (GDPR).

liability.title: 2. User responsibility

Users guarantee that they collect, process and enter persons in accordance with the provisions of the GDPR. In particular, they are committed to:
  • Obtain the explicit consent of the persons concerned before any data collection;
  • provide persons concerned with the necessary information on the use of their data;
  • Respect people's rights (right of access, rectification, erasure, etc.).
liability.content2:
Users are committed to:
  • Provide exact, complete and up -to -date information;
  • Protect data entered against unauthorized access.
liability.content3:
Users are committed not to enter illicit, incorrect or contrary to the law in the context of the use of the site. This includes, without the page on it:

  • Discriminatory content or encouraging violence;

Luc Aucoin reserves the right to delete any non -compliant content or to suspend access to the site. non-compliance with these rules.

data-usage.title: 3. Use of data

These data will never be voluntarily used for commercial purposes or shared with third parties for marketing purposes.

welcome.title: 🚀 Welcome to Registry!
welcome.introduction: I'm delighted to welcome you here. This site was designed to help you easily manage the entries and outputs of your participants in a collective reception of minors.
welcome.option: For each of the projects, you can create access profiles to give access to your project to other users, manage their movements, follow their activities and many other options.
welcome.invitations: You will find your invitations to projects by clicking on your name at the top of the screen. You can accept or refuse these invitations. If you accept, you can use the associated access profile with the invitation to access the project.
welcome.begin: Let's go! To start, if you want to create your own project, you can do it by clicking on the “Create a project” button below. If you want to join an existing project, you can do it by clicking on the button below.
